reviews.t: This is a perfect peptide serum with HA
reviews.x: This is a perfect peptide serum with HA. It’s light, hydrating and plumps from the first application. After using it repeatedly it just makes skin look and feel so much younger. Only thing is that it’s three or more times the price here than on the ordinary site. If you need it fast this is the place to get it otherwise save some money and buy it direct.

reviews.t: Works better than any other serum.
reviews.x: I love this product!!! It does exactly what it says it does!! I'm hooked on the Ordinary company products. This stuff is my new go to, plus I save a ton of money from smashbox and it actually works better.

THIS PRODUCT IS INTENDED FOR ONE PURPOSE....."reduce the look of static and dynamic wrinkles"......AND I CAN TELL YOU I HAVE USED ONLY THIS PRODUCT FOR A YEAR AND IT HAS NOT REDUCED ANYTHING EXCEPT MY POCKET...MOST PEOPLE DONT EVEN KNOW WHY THEY BUY OR USE THIS PRODUCT....I GET A LAUGH READING OTHERS REVIEWS ON HOW IT MAKES THEIR SKIN GLOW.........HAHAHAHAHA...........IT IS SUPPOSED TO REDUCE THE LOOK OF WRINKLES AND IT DOES NOT AT ALL, PERIOD....

This product was described by a user as “Botox in a bottle”. I ordered a bottle a few weeks ago. The speed at which differences are noticed will impress you. Literally it works pretty close to results like Botox. Don’t overuse because you might find your skin is itchy.

reviews.t: another Ordinary item not their best
reviews.x: a lot of promises! These Ordinary products are great on price long on hopes i gave this particular product away it added nothing to a skin care regimen.

I switched to Ordinary Matrixyl about a year ago. I really try to take good care of my skin especially now that I’m  almost 80. Sun damage, living in high altitude, dryness and air pollution needs attention. I believe along with good exercise, nutritious food and skin products, this has helped make my skin smoother. Ordinary is not expensive. Many believe the more expensive products are better. Not necessarily so.

Still neutral on the subject. Almost gone. Bought it and se simultaneously with the Buffet. Skin is less dry not not really seen much change. Used twice a day. Had no irritation from either product. The Ordinary has many products and may move on. This mature skin needs more help that this.

Ok there is no better value on peptides out there.  Now will peptides work for you?  This is the product to buy to find out.  I actually think I do see a little lifting.  But  I sometimes feel a little sticky.  Well I use a lot...because it's so inexpensive.  I use this during the day and hyalauric acid at night.  I'm 70.  My skin looks better than most 50 year olds.  No wrinkles at all, but it's really hard to combat the sag, especially at the jawline.

Este producto es maravilloso siempre e mantenido el cuidado de mi rostro pero ninguno me había dejado tanta suavidad en el tiempo que lo estoy utilizando hasta noto que mis líneas están desapareciendo. Gracias por tan excelente producto. Buen precio y entrega rápida

If I could give this 100 stars I would! This product came highly recommended and I am a HUGE fan of all things “The Ordinary”. Their products are magical as far as I’m concerned!

I’m 43. I smoke. I like the sun. I was seriously starting to research alternatives. This stuff in conjunction w the ordinarys argireline , and their hylauronic acid 2 % 2x a day has saved my face! Lol. Seriously. I wish I took before pics. Its softened ALL of my lines a noticeable amount! And given my skin a long forgotten glow.  It’s cheap enough that I don’t care if I have to use it all forever. So happy. (I do give credit to using these 3 products together)
Love all The Ordinary products. Great quality at affordable prices
I feel like they work. It might be that I am also washing my face 3x a day but I feel like its helping my skin. It feels good on my skin. However Ulta has it for a few bucks cheaper.

This is a great skin cream. I don't break out in using this product which I usually do with other products. I use it morning and evening. I don't expect miracles as I am older but I appreciate what this serum does. However, the price on Amazon is too high!  I have found this product elsewhere for a much better price. Amazon has great prices usually but they are off base on this one!

reviews.t: Good so far, thick and sticky.
reviews.x: Too early to know for sure as I’ve been using for just a few weeks, first bottle about half used.  It’s thick and kindof sticky, so I follow it up with some Aureuvedic oil blend at nighttime get everything pressed in.  I use it in conjunction with the copper serum because I hear both are good at night and can be used together.  I’ll update more later if there’s more to add!

Very happy with this purchase! I recently went through a derma roller experience and this was the serum used afterwards. This serum really hydrates and makes you feel like a million bucks afterwards. I use a few drops after I get out of the shower as a proplyatic and am very pleased. Would highly recommend.

Happy with product. Works best put onto wet skin. I have a spray bottle to mist my skin occasionally after applied because I live in an extremely dry climate. I use it on my surgery scar as well as elbows and knees. It helps hydrate more than just your face.

I enjoy trying out different skin care products, and have heard a lot about Matrixyl, so thought I'd give it a try.  I do think it has helped give my skin a nice smooth texture, and helped a bit with firmness.  I do get compliments on my skin, and I have re-ordered this, so it must be doing something right. claims.text: Many reviewers report visible improvements in skin texture, fine lines, and firmness, describing the product as effective and even comparable to Botox-like results.
Reviewers frequently praise the product as excellent value for money, especially compared to pricier brands.
A notable minority report seeing no change or results, feeling the product did not deliver on its promises.
Several reviewers mention the product is light, hydrating, and non-irritating, though a few note stickiness or potential itchiness with overuse.
